name: stash-dashboard
description: Personal assets & project management dashboard: smart ZIP projects, link previews, and file storage.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names server,client --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.render:build: npm run db:migrate -w server && npm run build
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w server
